description: The plot illustrates how Accuracy@1 (percent) varies with the number of child nodes (tree width) for two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The x-axis is labeled “Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)” on a linear scale with values shown at 1, 3, 5, and 7 (range 1–7). The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy@1 (%)” on a linear scale spanning roughly 15 to 38, with regularly spaced tick marks at 15, 20, 25, 30, and 35. The GPT-4o series is drawn as a medium-blue solid line with circular markers and annotated values, increasing from 24.4 at x=1 to 28.9 at x=3, rising further to 34.4 at x=5, then decreasing to 31.1 at x=7. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet series is drawn as a lighter blue solid line with “x” markers and annotated values, starting at 26.7 at x=1, increasing to 27.8 at x=3, then decreasing to 24.4 at x=5 and further to 20.0 at x=7.
